citation.title: Skilful precipitation nowcasting using deep generative models of radar
citation.authors: Ravuri, S.; Lenc, K.; Willson, M.; Kangin, D.; Lam, R.; Mirowski, P.; Fitzsimons, M.; Athanassiadou, M.; Kashem, S.; Madge, S.; Prudden, R.; Mandhane, A.; Clark, A.; Brock, A.; Simonyan, K.; Hadsell, R.; Robinson, N.; Clancy, E.; Arribas, A.; Mohamed, S.

topic: Deep generative probabilistic nowcasting of precipitation from UK/US radar (meteorology, not plasma).
own_question: Can a conditional GAN produce skilful, non-blurry probabilistic precipitation nowcasts 5-90 min ahead from 20 min of past radar?
actual_method_and_evidence: Conditional GAN (DGMR) with spatial/temporal discriminators and a grid-cell regularizer. Baselines: PySTEPS, UNet and axial attention. Trained on UK 2016-2018 and tested on 2019; a weekly split and US MRMS data are also reported. Metrics: CSI, CRPS, PSD and economic value, plus a study with 56 meteorologists. Radar-derived labels are used as truth. The task is future-field prediction, not estimation of a current report.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In an unrelated domain, per-cell skill scores and expert judgments of forecast usefulness need not agree. This motivates using several evaluation views.
claim_checks.qualification: This is the authors' interpretation for precipitation nowcasting. It does not transfer as evidence to CES or plasma diagnostics.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: The inputs are 4 past radar frames at 5-min intervals. The targets are 18 future frames. This setup is future prediction, unlike our current-report nowcast.
validation_if_relevant: Yearly split (2019 test), a weekly split, and US data. Significance tests are paired permutation tests over alternating weeks.
forbidden_inferences: Implying any relevance to KSTAR, CES, Ti, or BES/ECEI
Treating GAN results as support for the performance of our estimators
Equating precipitation future forecasting with our current-report nowcasting
Citing it as plasma prior work
reason_to_include_or_exclude: This is a cross-domain nowcasting example. At most, it could serve as an optional single citation on multi-metric evaluation. It is not needed for the core framing.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
